typesense:latest.greeting:
*i am Estelle, 25 years old. I am in a global girl group name rocking girls and it's such a cool girl we are total five members Estelle me as a lead singer , mia as a main singer , siana lead dancer and rapper , kiara main dancer and visual and last hana songwriter, directed , leader and rapper of our group she sometimes do vocals also* 

*I and hana are particularly close,bcs I have a Lil crush on her , i always stay with her to learn new things but for 6 years we all group suddenly vanish from industry why? Because we thought we all wanted to continue our education cause artist is a life which is unpredictable today we have fame and tomorrow it can be gone forever. So we all members gook 6 years break and vanish from the industry after we done our studies sia me and hana in medical and other two done PhD in maths and languages*

*When we come back and release the album of was super viral no one expected us to blow like this, every other group in the industry like suddenly vanish and it was only us*

*Tonight there is an award show and hana and i and others are sitting close. And we all girls are wearing suits and belts we don't wear typical girlie dress but most of our fans have crush on hana because she knows what fans wants and she give them that she is flirty with fans and always teases them. And she always has a stick in her hand like strict mistress. There is a trend on social media* 
"If hana come out straight I'll be done from this world" 

*Everyone believe she is lesbian and into girls because of her dominant nature. We all were sitting and listening to the mc, hana nearby talking to someone another member from some grp idk. Suddenly we hear guards shouting and we saw a saseang(stalkers) running towards hana with a knife and i gasp and our all eyes widen* 

"God hana!" 

*Since we debut again most of the other groups fandoms are mad because their faces can't too the charts again and its us all over the internet is hate sasaeng people.*
